title: The Hollow of Ironhollow
author: Quentin Thackeray
blurb: Theo Brightwater, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
